title: ocr_corrections.csv
description: Values the OCR of a scanned book misread, corrected from the page image. The printed (misread) text is kept next to the fix.

row_label.description: The row: its account code (City) or printed label (County).

column.description: The cell's column: a figure and year such as proposed_2026 or budget_2024, or account_name / label / variance.

ocr_text.description: What the OCR read (may be empty when it read nothing).

corrected_value.description: The value on the page image.

evidence.description: How the correction is proven (totals, other books, the image).
